record.paper_title: Two Open Problems for Absolutely Convergent Dirichlet Series
record.context_brief: Sharp constant in the S^0_ψ(Λ) half-plane bound
record.original_question: Let ψ∈L_1, let S^0_ψ(Λ) be the class of Dirichlet series F∈S^0(Λ) such that |a_n|≤e^{λ_n/ψ(λ_n)} for all sufficiently large n, and let M(x,F)=sup_t |F(x+it)| and μ(x,F)=max_n |a_n|e^{xλ_n}. Assume h∈L_0 and that conditions (7) and (5) of the paper hold, so that for every F∈S^0_ψ(Λ) there exist c>0 and x_0<0 with M(x,F)<μ(x,F) h(c/|x|) for all x∈[x_0,0). What is the exact, i.e. sharp, value of the constant c for which this inequality can always be guaranteed?

evidence.quote: For ψ∈ L1 let S0 ψ(Λ) denote the class of Dirichlet series F∈ S0(Λ) such that |an|≤ exp{ λn / ψ(λn) }, n ≥ n0.
Corollary 1. If ψ∈ L1, h ∈ L0 and conditions(7), (5) hold, then (∀F∈ S0 ψ(Λ))(∃c > 0)(∃x0 < 0)(∀x∈ [x0, 0)): M(x, F) < µ(x, F)h(c/|x|).
Question 2. What is the exact value of constant c in the previous inequality?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Lambda=(\lambda_n)_{n\ge 1}$ be a strictly increasing sequence of nonnegative real numbers with $\lambda_n\to\infty$, and let $S^0(\Lambda)$ denote the class of (general) Dirichlet series
$$F(s)=\sum_{n\ge 1} a_n e^{s\lambda_n}$$
that converge absolutely in the open left half-plane $\{\operatorname{Re} s<0\}$. For $x<0$ and $F\in S^0(\Lambda)$ set
$$M(x,F)=\sup_{t\in\mathbb{R}}|F(x+it)|,\qquad \mu(x,F)=\max_{n\ge 1}|a_n|e^{x\lambda_n}\;.$$
Let $L_1$ denote the class of positive, continuous, nondecreasing functions $\psi:[a,\infty)\to(0,\infty)$ tending to $\infty$ such that $\psi(t)/t$ is nonincreasing and $\int^\infty dt/(t\psi(t))<\infty$ (so $\psi\in L_1$), and let $L_0$ denote the class of positive, continuous, nondecreasing functions $h:[b,\infty)\to(0,\infty)$ tending to $\infty$. For $\psi\in L_1$, let
$$S^0_\psi(\Lambda)=\{F\in S^0(\Lambda): |a_n|\le \exp(\lambda_n/\psi(\lambda_n))\ \text{for all sufficiently large }n\}.$$
Assume that $h\in L_0$ together with $\psi$ satisfy the standard compatibility conditions ensuring that for every $F\in S^0_\psi(\Lambda)$ there exist $c=c(F)>0$ and $x_0=x_0(F)<0$ such that
$$M(x,F)<\mu(x,F)\,h\!\left(\frac{c}{|x|}\right)\qquad \text{for all } x\in[x_0,0).$$
Determine the sharp (smallest) value of the constant $c>0$ for which this inequality is guaranteed to hold for every $F\in S^0_\psi(\Lambda)$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an explicit open question about identifying the sharp constant in a half-plane majorization for the class $S^0_\psi(\Lambda)$. A web search for recent literature on absolutely convergent Dirichlet series and related bounds (including a recent 2025 paper on lower bounds for absolutely convergent Dirichlet series and the pits property) does not reveal any resolution of the sharp-constant question. Status appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Lower Bounds for Absolutely Convergent Dirichlet Series and Pits Property
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on bounds for absolutely convergent Dirichlet series, with no mention of resolving the sharp constant c in M(x,F)<μ(x,F)h(c/|x|).
status_evidence.claim: No published resolution of the sharp constant question was located.
